name: pack-blog-metaobjects
description: Migrates blog content authored in the Pack Digital CMS platform (blogs/articles built from Pack 'sections') into native Shopify metaobject entries that can be attached to Shopify articles and rendered from Liquid. Use when a task mentions Pack Digital, Pack CMS, Pack sections, migrating a Pack blog/article, or converting Pack content blocks into Shopify metaobjects. NOT for Pack's Hydrogen storefront rendering, NOT for non-blog Pack content (pages, product pages, collection pages) unless the task explicitly asks to extend this same pattern to them.
